sentences.text:
This application has been filed by the Appellant under Section 389 Cr.P.C. seeking suspension of
sentence and release the applicant on bail, in case Fir No. 406/2017 dated 20.07.2017, under
Sections 376/506/509 Ipc registered at Ps: Rajouri Garden.
3. Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
4. Status report be filed by the State before the next date of hearing.
5. Nominal Roll be also requisitioned before the next date of hearing.
6. Guardian of prosecutrix shall be informed of filing of this application and next date of hearing, by the Investigating Officer.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
